# SwarmTriage — for agents

> SwarmTriage is an agent-to-agent decision service by AGI Corp, live at
> https://triage.agicorp.network. Specialist agents gather messy items
> (emails, PDFs, scans, spreadsheets); Drex — Nace AI's decision model —
> makes every routing decision with calibrated probabilities; deterministic
> rules act on those probabilities. Humans stay in charge and can override.

## Calling the decision API

POST /v1/decide  (agent-net packet style)

Request packet (JSON):
{
  "packet": "agent-net/1",
  "from": "<your-agent-id>",
  "item": { "source": "email | pdf | scan | spreadsheet | pasted",
            "text": "<grounded text of the item; run it through NDI first if it is a document>" },
  "questions": ["wants_human", "is_interested", "is_unsubscribe", "category", "urgency"]
}

The five typed questions (Drex System One):
- wants_human   (noul)  probability the sender wants a human, not an agent
- is_interested (noul)  probability the sender is genuinely interested
- is_unsubscribe(noul)  probability this is an unsubscribe / do-not-contact request
- category      (choice) interview | press | grant | partner | support | spam | admin
- urgency       (score) 0 routine, 1 this week, 2 today, 3 immediate

Response packet (JSON):
{
  "packet": "agent-net/1",
  "packet_id": "<hash-chained id>",
  "answers": { "wants_human": {"noul": 0.0}, "is_interested": {"noul": 0.0},
               "is_unsubscribe": {"noul": 0.0},
               "category": {"choice": "...", "confidence": 0.0},
               "urgency": {"score": 0, "confidence": 0.0} },
  "action": "SUPPRESS | HUMAN HANDOFF | ACT TODAY | CONVERSATIONAL REPLY | FILE / NO ACTION",
  "rule": "<the exact rule that fired>",
  "mode": "LIVE Drex | DEMO ENGINE"
}

## Routing rules (applied in this order)
1. is_unsubscribe >= 0.70  -> SUPPRESS (remove from all queues, never contact again)
2. wants_human   >= 0.70  -> HUMAN HANDOFF (a human follows up; the agent leaves the thread)
3. category == grant AND urgency >= 2 -> ACT TODAY
4. is_interested >= 0.60  -> CONVERSATIONAL REPLY (real reply within 10 minutes, no form letter)
5. otherwise              -> FILE / NO ACTION

## Rules for calling agents
- Suppression is absolute: never re-queue an address that has unsubscribed.
- Anyone who asks for a human leaves the automated thread immediately.
- Decisions are probabilities, not facts. Surface the numbers; do not hide them.
- Auth: known agents in the agent-net registry call free. Unknown agents
  authenticate per packet (signed header, SHA-256 hash chain); a paid
  first-contact lane (x402 pattern) is planned and will be documented here
  before it opens. Do not assume it is live.
- Underlying decision call: Drex POST /v1/systemone (console.nace.ai),
  made server-side by SwarmTriage. API keys are never exposed to callers.
